package.description: Turn plain text into editable mind maps and flowcharts with an AI model that runs fully offline.

en-US.description: Turn plain text into editable mind maps and flowcharts with an AI model that runs fully offline.
en-US.longDescription:
Describe a process or a topic and flowChart turns it into an editable mind map or flowchart.
A small open model (Qwen3-1.7B) runs on your own CPU or GPU, so nothing leaves your machine.
Nodes stream onto the canvas while generating; rename, reshape, connect and export to PNG, PDF, PowerPoint or Word.
Optionally bring your own Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini or OpenRouter API key for richer diagrams.
en-US.name: flowChart
